text: Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary. Join: compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Join: drug_indication ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND drug_indication.efo_term = 'non-small cell lung carcinoma'. Sort: None. Limit: None.
